training.algorithm: chance-sampled MCCFR; unclipped cumulative regrets; conditional uniform average
training.coverageRule: Only rows with nonzero cumulative sampled raw regret in at least one action are published. Zero-regret rows are conservatively withheld; class visits alone do not prove informative history coverage.

criteria.rationale: Diagnostic product tolerances: 1 percentage point mean / 5 points maximum movement; 0.01 BB per dealt hand. Not a multiplayer Nash theorem. Verified requires a certified full-deck BR upper bound and independent audit.

excluded: Rare histories and response fitting uncertainty
Normal raises, limps, postflop, ICM excluded
validation.scope: Restricted fold/jam/call game only; not full-game GTO; no normal raises, limps or postflop betting

diagnostics.evScope: Unconditional seat EV per dealt hand; NOT hand-specific or conditional-on-history EV

evaluation.scope: fixed fitted deviations only; NOT an upper bound on true best response
